title: A frame-breaking face widens no box
notes: A Legendary or Mythic face that breaks its frame (R3344000) scales its near plane's subject from the foot, which widens it too; the plane's clip-path hid the sideways growth but laid no box, so a face at a box's right edge widened the box (the deck editor at 390x844, by 1.5 px, spec 46's R4349000). The plane now clips sideways for layout too (`overflow-x: clip`) and still lets the subject rise over the window's top (`overflow-y: visible`). How cards look only: no card plays differently.

player.title: A frame-breaking face widens no box
fixes: A Legendary or Mythic card whose art rises over its frame no longer pushes a phone's deck editor a pixel or two wider than the screen.
